description: Guides elements to the latest version of this template, as a list of paths, oldest first. Each path is either an update, within this template, identified by `beforeVersion`, or a migration from a different template, identified by `templateId`. A path describes what changed and, with hints, moves user input to new bindings.

beforeVersion.description: Updates only. The path applies to elements on a version of this template below it.

templateId.description: Migrations only. The id of the template to migrate from. Elements using it are offered the migration.

message.description: Migrations only. Text shown where the migration is offered.

changes.description: What changed, and what users need to check or do, as Markdown. Applications may show it before users update or migrate.

hints.description: Optional. Values to move. Each hint moves the value of the `from` binding to the `to` binding.

from.description: The binding to read the value from.

to.description: The binding to move the value to.

values.description: Maps values, for example `{ "GET": "get" }`. Use `*` to map any other value; empty values are not moved.
